A chain letter stirs up trouble and causes havoc with Moesha’s family and friends.

title: Moesha

Moesha gets her first taste of independence when she gets a job and earns her own money.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E9 — Niece
Moesha learns to appreciate Dee and see her in a new light with the help of Dee’s visiting niece Charisse.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E10 — Reunion
Moesha’s father arranges a reunion of Moesha’s childhood playgroup (his motive is to sell Saturns).

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E11 — The Ditch Party
Moesha reports on the annual school “ditch day”, but will not reveal who attended or who her sources are.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E12 — Mother’s Day
When Moesha borrows money from Frank to buy a mother’s day present for Dee, but only gives Dee socks, Frank is upset.

Malcolm and his sister vie for the attention of the same woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E5 — A Police Officer And A Gentleman
Eddie is jealous when Nicolette agrees to accompany her commander to a police department dance.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E6 — The Courtship Of Eddie's Mother
Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E7 — Trading Spaces
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E8 — Like Water For Chocolate Cookies
Malcolm faces a difficult decision in order to get Simone to keep making her extraordinary cookies.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E9 — Dream Racer
Eddie ignores Nicolette's premonition and agrees to fill in for an injured race car driver.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.
